scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Electromagnetic tails and the Kerr–Newman Penrose inequality” (preprints/Electromagnetic-tails-and-the-Kerr-Newman-Penrose-inequality-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ffdf93f60ad3ab23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the class of smooth axisymmetric source-free electrovacuum exteriors specified in Section 1.1, both of the following occur. (i) There are data with Qe = Qb = 0, A > 8π |J| , m2 < A 16π + 4πJ2 A . (ii) There are data with Qe = Qb = 0, A > 8π |J| , m2 = A 16π + 4πJ2 A , for which no smooth spacelike embedding into the Kerr–Newman spacetime with param- eters (m, J, Qe, Qb) induces the given metric, second fundamental form, and electro- magnetic fields. All these examples are maximal, trg K = 0, on Ω = {x ∈ R3 : |x| ≥ 1}, with connected boundary S = {r = 1}. Both electromagnetic fields are nonzero.
